description: Source code for PdfSharpDefaultSigner class implementing digital signing using .NET cryptography classes, including timestamping support.

classes.name: PdfSharpDefaultSigner
classes.description: Implements digital signing of PDFs using .NET cryptography, supports timestamping via RFC3161.

methods.name: PdfSharpDefaultSigner
methods.description: Constructor initializing signer with certificate, digest type, and optional timestamp URI.

methods.name: GetSignatureSizeAsync
methods.description: Calculates and returns the size of the signature block.

methods.name: GetSignatureAsync
methods.description: Creates a digital signature for the provided PDF stream.

methods.name: AddTimestampFromTSAAsync
methods.description: Adds a timestamp token from a TSA to the signature (only in .NET 6+).
